economy.summary: In a campaign position statement, supports Pennsylvania's ATV trail program in Potter, Tioga, and Bradford counties, citing roughly $13.1 million in economic activity from the Northcentral Regional ATV Trail system and its support for local tourism businesses; his site does not detail a broader economic platform.
economy.short: Supports ATV trail program, citing local tourism economy benefits.

healthcare.summary: Calls for bipartisan state action to increase healthcare staffing in rural counties, improve outreach so veterans know about VA benefits and residents know about hospital charity care programs, and support the charitable missions of local hospitals.
healthcare.short: Proposes rural healthcare staffing, benefits outreach, supporting local hospitals.

energy.summary: Opposes hyperscale data center development in the district, saying data centers' water consumption can deplete regional groundwater and their electrical demand pressures the grid and raises energy prices for residents; calls for community conversations with transparency about water use, power demand, and tax incentives before projects proceed.
energy.short: Opposes hyperscale data centers, citing water use and utility rates.

economy.summary: His campaign platform says he will always be there to help grow and support the small and large businesses in the area and throughout the Commonwealth, and that he is committed to reducing government regulations.
economy.short: Pledges to support business growth and reduce government regulations.

taxes.summary: His campaign platform lists property tax reform among the issues he describes himself as working hard on.
taxes.short: Says he is working on property tax reform.

abortion.summary: His campaign platform says he firmly believes in the sanctity of all human life and will be a voice for the voiceless by continuing to support pro-life legislation.
abortion.short: Supports pro-life legislation, citing sanctity of human life.

education.summary: His campaign platform says he supports improving education so children are prepared for the future; it does not detail specific education proposals.
education.short: Says he supports improving education; no specific proposals listed.

healthcare.summary: His campaign's opioid-crisis platform pledges to fight for treatment and recovery resources for people with addiction and counseling for families, to improve access to treatment and recovery services, and to work with insurance companies to educate their customers; the platform does not detail a broader healthcare position.
healthcare.short: Pledges improved opioid treatment access; no broader healthcare platform.

energy.summary: Supports responsible natural gas exploration and the job creation he says comes with it, calling the industry Pennsylvania's biggest potential for job growth; opposes taxing the gas industry as the answer and says he will support the landowner first while seeking common sense and balance.
energy.short: Supports responsible gas exploration; opposes taxing the gas industry.

guns.summary: His campaign platform says he will always defend the Second Amendment right as an American, while continuing to bring into focus the mental health issues of today.
guns.short: Pledges to defend Second Amendment; focus on mental health.
